description: This Java class 'Support' provides a utility method to create a backward-compatible styleable array by mapping local styleable attributes to remote ones, optimizing for local contexts, and handling resource identification across different package contexts.

classes.name: Support
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for resource styleable compatibility across different contexts.

methods.name: createBackwardCompatibleStyleable
methods.description: Creates a styleable array compatible with a remote context by mapping local attribute IDs to remote attribute IDs, with optimization for local contexts.
